criteria.text: All security-relevant JSON boundaries use one strict duplicate-member-aware parser. Duplicate decoded object keys at any depth, including escape-equivalent keys, are rejected for change_json, scope prior/applied bytes, and before_snapshot_json before validation, claim, target mutation, projection, or status change.
criteria.red_evidence: Node 22 reviewer probes accepted duplicate scopePatch/add/current-map/snapshot keys and applied last-member-wins semantics at db78072b. The first permanent slice failed 13/13 before production changes.
criteria.green_evidence: A shared lexical validator plus JSON.parse rejects decoded duplicate members at every depth while preserving exact raw bytes. The focused slice passed 13/13.

criteria.text: Scope semantics fail closed: null allowlist bytes retain their unrestricted meaning and cannot be treated as empty; smuggled sibling/alias operations are rejected; state/delta constructors enforce runtime kind families; normal array, tools-map, and core-permission mutations remain supported.
criteria.red_evidence: Node 22 probes narrowed null unrestricted allowlists, accepted nested/alias operations, and constructed snapshots with unsupported runtime kinds at db78072b. The permanent slice initially failed 10 cases with one valid control passing.
criteria.green_evidence: Null allowlist add/remove, runtime kind mismatch, and refine-scope smuggling now reject before side effects; focused slice passed 11/11.

criteria.text: One shared duplicate-aware recursive scope-bearing detector is used by risk classification, unattended apply, human validation, snapshot/revert safety, and mislabeled payload handling. ScopePatch presence, canonical scope fields, malformed/split scope targets, and scope aliases are human-gated regardless of nesting; unrelated prose and unrelated recipePatch.add/set/unset remain low risk.
criteria.red_evidence: Node 22 probes classified empty/null/malformed/nested/direct/split scope payloads low, auto-applied one, and marked unrelated recipePatch.add high at db78072b. The permanent detector/gate slice initially failed 10 cases.
criteria.green_evidence: One shared recursive detector now gates classifier, unattended apply, human preparation, and revert, including operations nested below an agent-config id or typed target while leaving unrelated recipe operations low risk.

criteria.text: Every generic proposal status transition is a source-status compare-and-set with RETURNING and zero-row conflict handling in SQLite and PostgreSQL. A stale measuring-to-active writer cannot overwrite a completed measuring-to-reverted transition or vice versa.
criteria.red_evidence: The Node 22 race probe paused measuring-to-active after its read, completed revert, then observed the stale writer restore active under reverted target bytes at db78072b. The permanent repository slice initially failed 3 cases.
criteria.green_evidence: SQLite and PostgreSQL UPDATE statements bind the observed source status and RETURNING row. Real SQLite race coverage proves exactly one writer wins; focused slice passed 3/3.

criteria.text: Scope target CAS and proposal reverted transition, including measurement patch fields, commit in one authoritative database transaction. Transaction failure leaves active/measuring plus applied bytes; durable commit leaves reverted plus prior bytes. Ambiguous post-commit errors never trigger one-sided compensation. Projection failure uses an exact atomic inverse transaction restoring both target and proposal state, or preserves concurrent bytes and reports reconciliation required.
criteria.red_evidence: Persistent verification-read failure produced durable reverted plus applied target bytes at db78072b. Generic status and target writes were separate operations. The initial lifecycle slice failed 9 cases while 3 controls passed.
criteria.green_evidence: The SQLite fixed-column primitive commits target and bound proposal CAS in one transaction, refuses PostgreSQL split-store operation before writes, and atomically inverses both rows after blocked/failed projection. Target/status CAS misses, trigger rollback, read outage, pre/post-commit throws, both snapshot versions, all projection outcomes, measurement patches, and repeated compensating-projection failure with reconciliation-required are covered.

criteria.text: Direct human claim primitives reject null, non-safe-integer, non-finite, and negative actors at runtime while preserving the documented local operator actor 0. Mislabeled scope payloads with missing, malformed, duplicate-key, legacy, or kind-incompatible snapshots cannot mutate, project, or change status.
criteria.red_evidence: The direct claim probe persisted a null actor, and nested scope payloads under refine-recipe transitioned to reverted with null/scalar/empty snapshots at db78072b. The actor slice initially failed 6 invalid actors while actor 0 passed.
criteria.green_evidence: The direct claim primitive requires a numeric actor in TypeScript and Number.isSafeInteger at runtime before SQL; NaN, infinity, oversized integers, fractions, negative values, strings, and null reject while actor 0 remains valid.

criteria.text: All prior W1 claim-first, exact snapshot, CAS, projection, compensation, legacy refusal, real route, SQLite/PostgreSQL parity, and build contracts remain green. The two reviewer scripts become green or are superseded by equivalent permanent tests whose preconditions prove the intended attack path.
criteria.green_evidence: Parent Node 22 external verification passed the exact requested 14-file matrix: 14/14 files, 396 passed, 1 existing skip, including the real ephemeral HTTP route suite. npm run build and git diff --check db78072b passed. The two original reviewer scripts now stop at the first newly fail-closed duplicate-member rejection and stale source-status conflict; equivalent attacks plus side-effect assertions are permanent tests.

parent_verification.focused_parent_follow_up: Six new RED failures for nested contextual scope detection, compensating projection reconciliation, safe-integer actor binding, and truthful ambiguous-commit route reporting; 93/93 focused tests passed after minimal fixes.
parent_verification.reviewer_reproducers: w1-adversarial-probes.ts stops at duplicate add rejection; w1-final-adversarial-probes.ts stops at stale source-status conflict.
parent_verification.acceptance: failed; superseded by corrective-6 architecture redesign

root_causes: Human approval can expose applied before target CAS and projection have succeeded.
Status-only CAS admits ABA when retry/compensation recreates a prior status.
Post-commit projection has no monotonic target revision fence and can overwrite a newer projection.
Strict JSON, scope detection, field-shape semantics, and reconciliation truth are not enforced at every status-changing boundary.

constraints: Strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR: permanent tests must fail at base_head before production changes.
No live Rhythm/OpenCode database access or mutation.
Use only in-memory SQLite, mocks, fixtures, and ephemeral listeners.
No persistent servers, external network actions, W2/W3/integration edits, or raw payload logging.
No dynamic eval or shell execution. SQL field names must come from fixed internal maps.
Do not claim acceptance; parent verification and two fresh independent reviews are mandatory.
